pagerbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT created: incident-19287 — High 5xx rate detected on inference-api-us-west (>= 10% over 5m). Pager sent to @ciara (oncall). Runbook: https://redwood/i/incident-runbooks/19287

ciara (oncall): I'm on it. paging team — is this customer-facing? any preliminary impact?

samir: early telemetry shows spike after a deploy at 02:10 UTC. stacktrace samples:
```
ERROR inference-runtime: kv_cache miss -> null deref at kernel.c:482
5xx: upstream handler panicked
```
Likely regression in runtime mem management on quantized kernels.

jon: flagged prod logs — multiple customers saw failed requests to /v1/generate in us-west. CS #INC-4512 opened, some timeouts, no data leakage reported so far.

ciara (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) rollback 02:10 deploy to v2.3.8 -> v2.3.7 2) scale fallback pool (dedicated-qa-quant) and route traffic via policy 'fallback-latency' 3) enable 1s circuit-breaker on model-serving route.

samir: rolled back deploy `kubectl set image deployment/inference runtime=runtime:v2.3.7 -n prod` and scaled fallback `rtr update route --route inference --variant fallback-quant --weight 20` — keeping an eye.

ops-rotations: handoff note: ciara -> jon in 25m. I'll watch the pagers for the next 30.

pagerbot: System: error rate fell below threshold at 02:34 UTC. incident status: mitigated. :white_check_mark:

ciara (oncall): Observed 5xx drop to normal after rollback and routing. Customer impact window ~02:10-02:33 UTC. CS will notify impacted customers. Moving to post-incident review.

maria: please schedule postmortem review. proposed: Wed 10:00 PT (Calendar: https://calendar/redwood/postmortems/19287). Agenda: timeline, root cause, remediation, communication.

linda: security note — we discovered audit log gap in cloud-audit-s3 between 02:12-02:22 UTC. looks like logclient rotated and one shard didn't flush. This affects evidence for a subset of API keys. Opening sec ticket SEC-3921.

sec-bot: Automated: SEC-3921 created. Required actions: preserve affected hosts, collect kernel logs, collect KMS audit trail, snapshot nodes

kyle: I'll create an S3 retention snapshot and enable immediate replication to internal-sec bucket: `aws s3 cp s3://cloud-audit-s3/2025/02/12/ s3://internal-sec/SEC-3921/ --recursive` — starting now.

samir: I pulled runtime core dumps from host inference-12.us-west and uploaded to secured bucket. saved KV cache dump and config `kv_cache_state.tar.gz` to s3://internal-sec/SEC-3921/artifacts/

linda: security request: DO NOT purge logs. preserve logs and evidence lock ID #EL-19287. Also need list of users who accessed admin console during window. @kyle can you pull CloudTrail entries and IAM sessions?

kyle: pulling CloudTrail. note: there is missing CloudTrail segment from 02:15-02:18 UTC, likely correlated to the same rotation issue. collecting what we have and will attach to SEC-3921.

maria: action items (high priority):
- samir: root cause analysis for runtime memory regression + PR to add safer null checks (due Fri EOD)
- kyle: consolidate audit evidence and produce timeline for SEC-3921 (due Thu 3pm PT)
- linda: draft compliance notification and retain evidence (due Thu EOD)
- ciara: update runbook with rollback checklist and circuit-breaker default (due Mon)
- maria: customer outreach draft for CS review (due Thu noon)

jon: also recommend a post-deploy smoke test step in CI to hit /v1/generate with quantized kernel variants — low-risk test suite added to prod-gate (I can own)

ciara (oncall): handing off to jon now. I'll be available but deferring active watch.

jon: acked. I'll lead the postmortem call and keep this thread updated. Closing incident in pager system but leaving thread open for remediation tracking.

sec-bot: Reminder: evidence preservation policy requires storing artifacts for 1 year for incidents with potential audit impact.

maria: I've created the postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/19287 — please add timeline entries and attach artifacts from s3://internal-sec/SEC-3921/

samir: adding kernel logs and core dumps to the doc. preliminary root cause: regression introduced by PR #8774 that changed KV cache free path under quantized path. will include reproducer and patch link.

linda: compliance follow-up — I'll schedule a meeting with legal and security for evidence review Fri 9am PT.

jon: thanks everyone. action items tracked in the postmortem doc. tagging @engineering-leads for awareness.

pagerbot: INCIDENT incident-19287 marked 'resolved' by ciara at 03:00 UTC. Follow-ups in SEC-3921 and PM-19287.

maria: final note: good coordination. please ensure runbook updates are PR'd and sec ticket has evidence before we close SEC-3921. :pray:
